label: Request Tracer (RequestTracer / OpenTelemetry/OpenTracing integration)
type: the SDK's request-tracing mechanism - default lightweight ThresholdLoggingTracer or a pluggable OpenTelemetry/OpenTracing-backed RequestTracer - capturing per-request timing spans, the SDK's own answer to 'why was this operation slow'
note: Recurs across concept-docs/best-practices.json, concept-docs/response-time-observability.json, howtos/observability-metrics.json, howtos/observability-tracing.json, howtos/transactions-tracing.json, ref/client-settings.json, ref/glossary.json - one of this round's observability family alongside sdk:orphan-reporter, sdk:health-check/sdk:ping/sdk:diagnostics and sdk:app-telemetry. NOT the same as sdk:orphan-reporter, which only fires for responses whose caller has already given up, or general request logging.
